# React State Task

Implement requested state behavior using `agents/react-state.agent.md`. Inspect the existing Redux Toolkit/React Query/Zustand/Context conventions and preserve the established solution. Define typed state, actions/slices or query/mutation hooks, loading/error/success transitions, reset behavior, and authorization boundaries. Add deterministic Jest/RTL-based unit tests for state transitions and affected workflows, wrapping connected components with a test store provider when Redux Toolkit is used.
